verdict.rationale: Devin sessions run in isolated cloud VMs with their own shell/browser/full repo access, configurable environment blueprints for a 'known-good state,' and a CLI --sandbox flag enforcing OS-level write/network isolation, all of which support testing in isolated environments away from live infrastructure. However, there is no explicit documentation addressing production-data isolation or masking, or confirmation that these sandboxes are guaranteed free of production data. missing for 10: explicit statement on production-data separation/masking, independent hands-on confirmation that sandbox testing never touches production data.
